figurative_meaning_en: Market free from government control; legal market
example_sentences_in_bangla: খোলাবাজারে সব ধরনের পণ্য পাওয়া যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: All kinds of goods are available in the open market.
The government has introduced an open market policy.
note: This idiom reflects modern economic liberalization in Bengali usage.
